name: Stripe
summary: Payments infrastructure: card and bank payments, Billing, Invoicing, Connect for platforms, Issuing, Tax, and Radar, the vendor's fraud product that blocks fraudulent payments and flags suspicious accounts in real time. For agents, the vendor publishes a hosted MCP server at mcp.stripe.com that searches the API and its knowledge base and reads and writes much of the Stripe API; it authenticates by OAuth, or by a restricted API key as a bearer token where a client cannot do OAuth; measured 401 with no credentials.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-19: the MCP server and API keys carry no price of their own and speak no 402 protocol. Stripe's fees are netted from each processed charge before payout (docs.stripe.com/payouts) and disputes debit the balance, so no bill is issued for the tool itself: 'none' is the nearest enum value.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-11 and again 2026-09-19, no credentials: MCP initialize at mcp.stripe.com answers 401; the Bearer challenge's resource_metadata value is unquoted (outside RFC 7235 grammar); the metadata names access.stripe.com/mcp as the OAuth server. OAuth, or a restricted API key as bearer.

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim for payments: the charge settles to the business's Stripe balance and "Stripe sends funds from your available balance to your bank account as payouts"; the disputes page (docs.stripe.com/disputes) adds "Stripe debits your balance for the payment amount and dispute fee".

Vendor's claim for Stripe Tax, which "uses your business address, tax registrations, product tax codes, customers' locations, and customer status to determine the correct tax rates", kept current by "tax researchers who monitor tax laws". Limit in the vendor's words: no registration, zero tax.

US state sales tax only: the vendor claims "Automated US filing is available in all 46 US locations with a state-level sales and use tax" through TaxJar, a Stripe company, remitting from the business's US bank account. Tax Complete plan; outside the US, filing is a partner app.

Amounts recorded in Stripe: the vendor's Invoicing product, where "You can send invoices to customers to collect payment or you can create an invoice and automatically charge a customer's saved payment method", with due terms, Stripe Tax treatment and EU/UK-aware sequential numbering.
